sge_enabled.description: Enable support for Sun/Oracle Grid Engine (SEG) via GRAM JobManager.

sge_qmaster_host.description: Hostname or FQDN of the SGE qmaster node (required for job submission).

sge_root.description: Base installation path of the SGE software (e.g., /opt/gridengine or /usr/local/gridengine).

sge_cell.description: Name of the SGE cell (commonly 'default', matches the cell configured on qmaster).

sge_qmaster_spool_dir.description: Directory where qmaster stores state and spool files. Must be writable by the Globus process.

sge_execd_spool_dir.description: Directory where execd daemons store state and spool files on compute nodes.

job_manager_script.description: Path to the Globus-provided SGE jobmanager script (required for GRAM integration).

job_manager_wrapper.description: Optional custom wrapper script to invoke before the jobmanager script (e.g., for environment setup). Leave empty if not used.

sge_allowed_queues.description: List of SGE queue names that users may submit jobs to. Only queues in this list will be available to GRAM.

items.description: Name of an SGE queue (must exist on qmaster and be accessible).

sge_default_queue.description: Default SGE queue to use when the user does not specify one in the job submission.

sge_max_jobs_per_user.description: Upper bound on the number of concurrent jobs allowed per user (0 = unlimited).

sge_max_walltime.description: Maximum walltime (in seconds) for any submitted job. Jobs requesting longer walltime will be rejected.

sge_max_cores_per_job.description: Maximum number of CPU cores that a single job may request.

sge_use_resource_limits.description: If true, enforce hard/soft limits defined by SGE resource request attributes (e.g., h_vmem, h_rt).
